verdicts.reason: A and B are almost identical, and both have the same serious flaws. The RSVP Free CTA has shrunk to a small pill with tiny text and sits in a row of four, smaller than the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS tags, so the call to action is buried. The 'Solstice Presents' kicker is detached under the logo, the left column of logo, tagline and can is cramped against the large title block, and the canvas is busier than the original. The only differences are that B has a slightly larger date, a wider ALL AGES pill and a slightly larger URL line. None of these changes the verdict.
